risk_definition: migration risk = blast radius × mathematical/execution complexity × current architectural coupling; it is not a model quality score
invariants: Do not freeze current public-estimator MRO as a compatibility contract.
Do not weaken A1 API contracts or A2 fitted-state atomicity.
Do not merge performance rewrites into architecture migration PRs.
Do not replace model-specific mathematics with a universal solver/search/temporal abstraction.
Do not let one public estimator inherit another in the target architecture.

GWR.numerical_gate: blocking external multi-software + deep smoother diagnostics
GWR.execution: streamed calibration/prediction distances; optional dense hat matrix
debts: base currently owns GWR-specific state/algorithms
golden sample for engine extraction
GWR.rationale: Central public estimator and architecture exemplar; a regression here has the widest blast radius despite the strongest numerical freeze.

MGWR.execution: dense reusable pairwise-distance cache; repeated backfitting; optional full/partial smoother matrices
debts: deep multiscale base is not final architecture
custom adaptive search cannot be replaced by ordinary GWR helper
MGWR.rationale: Repeated backfitting, scale-specific search, and exact smoother semantics make both numerical and memory behavior highly coupled.

GTWR.execution: spatial, temporal, and combined spatiotemporal distance components; dense/cache-heavy path
debts: deep spatiotemporal base is not final architecture
misleading ridge warning recorded for A5
GTWR.rationale: Geometry, time encoding, bandwidth search, and Gaussian diagnostics intersect; incorrect factoring can silently change the metric.

MGTWR.numerical_gate: MGWR + MGTWR model gates + A1/A2 contracts
MGTWR.execution: dense spatiotemporal components reused across multiscale backfitting
debts: public estimator inherits public estimator
multiscale and spatiotemporal responsibilities are entangled in inheritance
MGTWR.rationale: Combines the two most stateful families and currently uses forbidden concrete estimator inheritance.

RGWR.numerical_gate: RGWR robust-weight and failed-refit tests + frozen GWR gate
RGWR.execution: GWR execution plus iterative robust refits; filtered path requires full initial hat matrix
debts: public estimator inherits public estimator
RGWR.rationale: Robust logic is distinct but heavily reuses GWR internals; composition conversion must preserve robust-weight/hat semantics.

LCRGWR.execution: GWR-like neighbourhoods with model-specific local conditioning/ridge decisions
debts: public estimator inherits public estimator
specialized penalty semantics must not be folded into generic WLS
LCRGWR.rationale: Looks close to GWR structurally but its conditioning and penalty definitions are intentionally different.

GWGLM.execution: local iterative IWLS across spatial neighbourhoods
debts: public estimator inherits public estimator
_RIDGE=1e-8 intent must be audited before inheritance removal
GWGLM.rationale: Concrete inheritance hides a fundamentally different estimator loop; the existing ridge policy makes a mechanical extraction unsafe.

GWLasso.execution: local weighted standardization and repeated coordinate-descent/CV solves
debts: inherits algorithm-heavy regressor base even though solver semantics are non-WLS
GWLasso.rationale: Distance/kernel infrastructure can be shared, but the optimization problem and coefficient scaling are model-owned.

MixedGWR.execution: iterative global/local partial-regression path via private _mixed_gwr_core
debts: algorithm-heavy base use
private core exists but lifecycle/capability boundaries need normalization
MixedGWR.rationale: Already points toward composition, but global/local partitioning must remain model-specific during base thinning.

STWR.execution: spatiotemporal local weighting with model-specific temporal effect
debts: bare public class bypasses role base
must not be forced into GTWR raw-time distance semantics
STWR.rationale: Its temporal mathematics is qualitatively different from GTWR, so an apparently convenient common ST engine would be dangerous.

dependencies: uses public GWR internally for pure-GWR bandwidth selection
SGWR.execution: by default may materialize spatial, similarity, and combined n×n weights; alpha search can build full combined weights/hat
debts: bare public class
public estimator used as utility
dense storage policy mixed with statistical logic
SGWR.rationale: Statistical mixture and memory policy are entangled; migration must separate composition without changing alpha semantics.

dependencies: uses public GTWR instance as time conversion utility
SGTWR.execution: spatiotemporal weighting plus attribute-similarity weighting; potentially dense combined state
debts: bare public class
public estimator used as utility for time conversion
SGTWR.rationale: It crosses time, geometry, and similarity capabilities and currently depends on a full public estimator for a utility responsibility.

ScalableGWR.numerical_gate: explicit weighted-regression references + no-full-pairwise-distance tests + A1/A2 contracts
ScalableGWR.execution: cKDTree kNN + compressed moments/polynomial basis; intentionally avoids n×n pairwise distances
debts: bare public class
generic distance abstractions must not destroy compressed execution path
ScalableGWR.rationale: Its defining property is algorithmic scalability; a unified distance/solver migration could regress both memory complexity and formulas.

LGGWR.execution: learned latent geometry with repeated distance/objective evaluation; SciPy cdist path
debts: bare public class
learned geometry must remain model engine rather than ordinary core metric
LGGWR.rationale: The geometry itself is learned model state; treating it as a generic distance configuration would erase model semantics.

GRGWR.numerical_gate: direct local-WLS, connectivity, objective and prediction characterization + A1/A2 contracts
GRGWR.execution: dense distance features plus sparse graph/MST/regime topology and iterative reassignment
debts: bare public class
graph/topology state cannot be represented as ordinary metric capability
GRGWR.rationale: Combines spatial graph topology, clustering, local regression and discrete optimization; architecture changes can alter regime identities.

GWPCA.numerical_gate: independent GWmodel-formula translations + public Dublin bandwidth benchmark + A1/A2 contracts
GWPCA.execution: local weighted SVD/PCA across evaluation locations
debts: bare public class
adaptive tie/boundary rules need preservation before shared helper adoption
GWPCA.rationale: Numerically well characterized, but PCA-specific objective and adaptive semantics should not be routed through regression selectors.

GWDA.numerical_gate: independent weighted-statistics formulas + sklearn global-degenerate references + A1/A2 contracts
GWDA.execution: local class statistics and discriminant evaluation
debts: bare public class
classification selector semantics differ from regression
GWDA.rationale: Shared neighbourhood infrastructure is safe only if local covariance, prior and classification objective remain model-owned.

GWSS.numerical_gate: independent GWmodel weighted-moment/quantile/covariance formulas + A1/A2 contracts
GWSS.execution: local weighted summary matrices; weights may be retained
debts: bare public class
GWmodel-specific quantile/covariance conventions must not be replaced by generic statistics
GWSS.rationale: Formulas are reference-sensitive and differ from generic weighted-statistics conventions despite a simple public surface.

BootstrapGWR.numerical_gate: definition-level bootstrap statistic/p-value tests + frozen GWR gate + A1/A2 contracts
BootstrapGWR.execution: repeated GWR calibration; optional bootstrap-local tensor storage
debts: bare public class
eventually should depend on narrow GWR engine/protocol rather than concrete estimator where practical
BootstrapGWR.rationale: Already composition-oriented and isolated from base math; main risk is preserving GWR dependency and bootstrap storage semantics.
